email.upcoming_order.subject: Your next Cellexia delivery ships {next_date}
email.order_confirmed.subject: Order {order_name} confirmed — your Cellexia is on its way
email.order_confirmed.body:
Hello,

Thank you — your Cellexia order {order_name} is confirmed and being prepared with care.

We'll email you again the moment it ships. In the meantime, you can review or adjust your subscription anytime:
{portal_url}
email.order_shipped.subject: Your Cellexia order {order_name} has shipped
email.skip_confirmed.subject: Done — your next Cellexia order is skipped
email.skip_confirmed.body:
Hello,

As requested, we've skipped your next order — nothing ships and nothing is charged. Your schedule after that stays exactly the same.

Changed your mind, or need something sooner? Everything is one tap away in your account:
{portal_url}
email.unskip_confirmed.subject: Your next Cellexia order is back on
email.delay_confirmed.subject: Your next Cellexia delivery has been moved back
email.delay_confirmed.body:
Hello,

Done — we've moved your next delivery back as requested. Later deliveries keep their usual rhythm.

See your new date, or make any other changes, anytime:
{portal_url}
email.pause_confirmed.subject: Your Cellexia subscription is paused
email.resume_confirmed.subject: Welcome back — your Cellexia subscription is active
email.resume_reminder.subject: Your Cellexia subscription resumes on {resume_date}
email.resume_reminder.body:
Hello,

A gentle heads-up: your break is coming to an end, and your subscription resumes on {resume_date}. From then on, deliveries continue {frequency}.

Perfect timing? There's nothing to do.

Need a little longer, or want to make a change first? It's all one tap away:
{portal_url}
email.swap_confirmed.subject: Your Cellexia swap is confirmed
email.frequency_changed.subject: Your Cellexia delivery schedule has been updated
email.quantity_changed.subject: Your Cellexia order has been updated
email.address_updated.subject: Your delivery address has been updated
email.address_updated.body:
Hello,

Your delivery address has been updated — future Cellexia orders will ship to your new address.

If this wasn't you, please sign in and check your details, or simply reply to this email:
{portal_url}
email.cancel_confirmed.subject: Your Cellexia subscription is cancelled
email.cancel_confirmed.body:
Hello,

Your subscription has been cancelled — you won't be charged again, and no further orders will ship. Thank you for the time you've spent with us.

If you ever want to return, your details and subscriber benefits are saved and ready — restarting takes one tap:
{portal_url}

We'd love to welcome you back when the time is right.
email.payment_method_updated.subject: Your payment method has been updated
email.payment_method_updated.body:
Hello,

Thank you — your payment method has been updated and everything is set for your next order.

If you didn't make this change, please reply to this email straight away and we'll look into it.

Manage your subscription: {portal_url}
email.payment_failed_1.subject: A small hiccup with your Cellexia payment
email.payment_failed_1.body:
Hello,

We tried to process your Cellexia order of {amount}, but the payment didn't go through ({decline_human}). These things happen — an expired card, a bank check, a temporary limit — and they're easily fixed.

You may not need to do anything: we'll automatically try again over the next few days.

To be on the safe side, you can review or update your card in one tap — it takes less than a minute:
{cta}

Your deliveries are safe with us. Any questions, just reply to this email.
email.payment_failed_2.subject: Still holding your Cellexia order — a quick card check?
email.payment_failed_2.body:
Hello,

We've tried your payment of {amount} again, and it still hasn't gone through ({decline_human}). It's been {days_since_failure} days, and we're keeping your order safe in the meantime.

The quickest fix is usually a fresh card, or a quick word with your bank. Updating takes under a minute:
{cta}

We'll keep retrying on our side too — you won't need to start over. Any questions, just reply.
email.payment_failed_3.subject: Last try — let's keep your Cellexia routine going
email.payment_failed_3.body:
Hello,

We still haven't been able to process your payment of {amount} ({decline_human}), and we're nearly out of retries. We'd hate for your routine — and your results — to be interrupted.

One minute is all it takes to update your card and pick up exactly where you left off:
{cta}

If we can't process the payment soon, your subscription will simply be paused — no penalties, and you can restart anytime. We're here if you need a hand: just reply to this email.
email.card_expiring.subject: Your card ending in {card_last4} expires soon
email.card_expiring.body:
Hello,

A quick heads-up before it ever becomes a problem: the {card_brand} card ending in {card_last4} on your Cellexia subscription expires {expiry}.

Updating takes under a minute — one tap, no sign-in, and your deliveries continue without interruption:
{cta}

That's all — if you've already updated it, there's nothing to do.
email.threeds_action.subject: One quick confirmation to complete your Cellexia payment
email.threeds_action.body:
Hello,

Your bank is asking for a quick confirmation before we can complete your Cellexia payment of {amount}. It's a standard security step and takes just a moment.

Confirm securely below — you'll be taken to a Shopify-protected page, and we never see your card details:
{cta}

Once confirmed, your order continues as normal. Questions? Just reply to this email.
email.gift_announcement.subject: A little something extra in your next Cellexia order
email.gift_announcement.body:
Hello,

We love having you with us — so we've added a gift to your upcoming delivery: {gift_title}. It ships with your next order, on us.

Nothing to do, nothing to pay — just enjoy.

See what's coming: {portal_url}
email.milestone_gift.subject: You've reached a Cellexia milestone — your gift is on its way
email.milestone_gift.body:
Hello,

This is order {milestone_cycle} — a milestone worth celebrating. To say thank you, we've added a gift to your delivery, on us.

Consistency is where results live, and you've truly earned this one.

See your delivery: {portal_url}
email.rewards_unlocked.subject: Your Cellexia rewards are unlocked
email.winback_soft.subject: How is your skin doing?
email.winback_soft.body:
Hello,

By our reckoning, your last Cellexia delivery is starting to run low around now — so we wanted to check in, that's all.

Your results were built day by day, and your routine, your subscriber price and your rewards are saved exactly as you left them. Restarting takes one tap:
{portal_url}

No pressure — whenever the time is right.
email.winback_perk.subject: Come back to Cellexia — with a gift from us
email.winback_perk.body:
Hello,

We'd love to see you back — and we'd like to make it special. Restart your subscription now and we'll add a free gift to your first delivery back.

Your routine, subscriber price and rewards are all saved and ready. One tap and it's done:
{reactivate_url}

Warmly, Cellexia.
email.winback_discount.subject: Your welcome-back offer: {discount_pct}% off
email.winback_discount.body:
Hello,

One last nudge, and it's a good one: restart today and enjoy {discount_pct}% off your next {discount_cycles} orders — applied automatically, no code needed.

Your routine and rewards are saved exactly as you left them. One tap to pick up where you left off:
{reactivate_url}

This is the best offer we make — we'd love you to have it.
email.price_change_notice.subject: An update to your Cellexia subscription price
email.price_change_notice.body:
Hello,

We're writing well ahead of time, as promised: from {effective_date}, the price of {product_title} in your subscription changes from {old_price} to {new_price}.

Your subscriber discount still applies, and nothing changes before that date. If you'd like to review your options — frequency, products or anything else — your account is one tap away:
{portal_url}

Thank you for being with us. Questions? Just reply — a real person will answer.
email.stockout_delay.subject: A short delay to your next Cellexia order
email.stockout_delay.body:
Hello,

A quick note: {product_title} is temporarily out of stock, so we've moved your next delivery back by {delay_days} days rather than send your order incomplete.

Your schedule after that stays the same, and you won't be charged until your order ships.

Manage your subscription: {portal_url}
email.stockout_skip.subject: About your next Cellexia order
email.stockout_skip.body:
Hello,

We're sorry — {product_title} is out of stock, so we've skipped your upcoming order rather than charge you for something we can't send. Nothing ships and nothing is charged this cycle.

Your schedule continues as normal afterwards, and we're doing everything we can to restock quickly.

Manage your subscription: {portal_url}
email.stockout_substitute.subject: A small change to your next Cellexia order
email.stockout_substitute.body:
Hello,

{product_title} is temporarily out of stock, so to keep your routine on track we've included {substitute_title} in your next delivery instead — a substitution chosen with care.

Prefer to wait, or make a change? Your account is one tap away:
{portal_url}
email.otp_code.subject: {code} is your Cellexia sign-in code
email.otp_code.body:
Hello,

Your Cellexia sign-in code is:

{code}

It expires in {minutes} minutes. If you didn't request it, you can safely ignore this email — your account is untouched.
